fields.calculation: Manager notes pending occupants (implied 1 to reconcile 9-of-10 headline vs. 9 physical), but certified rent roll does not identify specific pending suites or count.
Per instruction: all-suite certified scheduled monthly rent (pre-amend Suite 001 $6,650) x 12 = (6,650+6,800+7,075+6,650+6,800+7,075+6,650+6,800+7,075+6,650) x 12 = 68,225 x 12 = 818,700.
Certified contemporaneous roll selected; archive (2026-06-30) is stale.
Reported NOI on trailing-12 cash statement.
Manager headline 9-of-10 leased includes pending occupants who have not taken possession, overstating occupancy vs. certified physical count.
All active leases expire 2029-08-31; no expiry within 12 months of 2026-08-31.
GL policy in force through 2027-06-30 with $2M aggregate limit.
Roof replacement labeled a capital improvement and shown at $0 in repairs; historical ledger does not commingle capital into opex.
Suite 001 rent change is a signed executed amendment; no unsigned rent proposal appears in the packet.
Lease excerpt states no free-rent concession applies at the evaluation date.
Note rate 6.5000% > floor 6.00%; sizing uses the note rate, floor does not bind.
Sized proceeds 5,088,492 exceed 4,300,000 payoff + 45,000 costs + 50,885 fee; net cash-out is +$692,607.

qualifications: Pending units count is not itemized in the certified rent roll; manager headline implies 1 pending but specific suite identity is not stated (reported as unknown, distinct from zero).
Asking price, market rent/sale comps, photos, and sponsor history are not supplied and are not fabricated (per instructions).
Legal, environmental, property condition and title diligence are pending routine workstreams; no findings of defect are asserted.

Underwriting follows the instructions strictly: GPR uses pre-amendment certified scheduled rent x 12 ($818,700). The signed Suite 001 amendment is separately reflected in in-place economics but does not alter the prescribed stabilized GPR assumption.
arguments.summary: Maple Crossing (10-suite, 32,150 SF retail, Columbus OH) shows physical occupancy of 9/10 units (90.4% of area) as of 2026-08-31; manager conflates pending occupants with physical occupancy. Underwriting per instructions produces EGI $781,090, NOI (before reserves) $528,420, NCF $525,420. Capitalized at 6.7500% -> value $7,828,449. Sizing at 6.5000% (note > floor) is LTV-bound: maximum loan $5,088,492, generating net cash-out of $692,607 after $4.3M payoff, $50,885 origination fee and $45,000 closing costs. Refinance is not short. Documented risks: pending-in-occupancy present; all other listed risks absent.
